notes.title: T2.0.10 Demo Update
notes.content:
NEW CONTENT

Hero Draft Mode is now available! Room hosts can select this mode in the room-settings panel before the match begins.

BUG FIXES

Fixed an issue where the item “Saddle” would not display values higher than 6.

Resolved a bug that caused UI widgets to scale up abnormally.

“Freeze”-type effects now trigger correctly under all conditions.

Eliminated a soft-lock that occurred when another player rolled dice during a showdown.

Turn progression will no longer begin before all pending effects have finished resolving.

Skin presets will no longer automatically revert to Preset 1.

Afternoon Tea now properly prevents the target player from acting.

Fixed an exploit that allowed the hero Wiz to pull back a player standing in front of him.

Lava Core can no longer be used an unlimited number of times.

BALANCE & TEXT UPDATES

Updated the tooltip for the “Hide” skill.
– If you are hidden on another player when a duel triggers, you still choose the duel target; however, the duel’s effects are swapped between you and the target.
– Non-targeted and targetless effects are no longer exchanged.
